status: FROZEN before any evaluator scoring; no Detoxify output exists for any dataset comment
study_status: additional analysis whose specification was frozen before evaluator scores were analyzed with respect to the external attributes; designed after the PERSUADE confirmatory study and NOT part of the original PERSUADE preregistration; the public timestamp is this repository's pushed freeze commit, not a registry entry, so the study is not described as preregistered
hypothesis: H0: S independent of A given Z, for each of eight identity-mention attributes A, where S is the discretized Detoxify-original toxicity score and Z is the exact seven-dimensional human toxicity annotation vector

dataset.name: Civil Comments / Jigsaw Unintended Bias identity-annotated subset (WILDS CivilComments source table)
dataset.reconstruction: hf_hub_download(repo_id='shlomihod/civil-comments-wilds', repo_type='dataset', filename='all_data_with_identities.csv', revision='3fbfeca80bad0f3aec37e72fa07eff222b6e752f'); verify SHA-256 above; this is the WILDS CivilComments source table (Koh et al. 2021), identical content to the official WILDS CodaLab bundle, which was unreachable (HTTP 500) at feasibility time
dataset.license: CC0 1.0 (Civil Comments release; Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification)
dataset.no_silent_substitution: no other mirror or version may be substituted after this freeze

primary_sample.rule: exactly one comment per article_id, chosen by the frozen hash rule; deterministic and independent of A, Z, S, comment text, row order, and article size
primary_sample.selection_key: SHA256(utf8('civil-comments-additional-audit-v1' + ':' + comment_id_as_string)), lowercase hex; within each article_id retain the comment with the lexicographically smallest key
primary_sample.missing_article_id: a row with empty article_id forms its own singleton pseudo-article and is retained (zero such rows exist in the frozen source)

dependence_sensitivity.sample: full 448,000-comment identity-annotated census, identical A, Z, evaluator, discretization, statistic, multiplicity correction, and permutation procedure
dependence_sensitivity.interpretation: answers whether the conclusion changes when all comments are used despite within-article dependence; a stronger census p-value never replaces a weaker primary result; the article-deduplicated analysis remains primary

attributes.family: WILDS CivilComments eight-identity family (externally defined, symmetric; no privileged primary identity)
attributes.rule: A = 1 iff the stored column value is >= 1/2 under exact rational comparison of the decimal string; A = 0 otherwise

column_mapping.LGBTQ: LGBTQ (binary column in the frozen source; verified equal to 1{max(homosexual_gay_or_lesbian, bisexual, other_sexual_orientation, transgender, other_gender) >= 0.5} on all 448,000 rows, and the unique such construction among subsets of the candidate columns)
column_mapping.other_religions: other_religions (binary column in the frozen source; verified equal to 1{max(jewish, hindu, buddhist, atheist, other_religion) >= 0.5} on all 448,000 rows, and the unique such construction)

attributes.multiplicity: all eight tests form one confirmatory family; Holm correction across the eight permutation p-values

conditioning.primary_z: exact observed seven-label fraction vector; two comments share a stratum iff all seven canonical values are equal
conditioning.canonical_representation: each stored decimal string is parsed exactly with Python fractions.Fraction (finite-decimal to reduced rational, no float round-trip); the stratum key is the '|'-joined 'numerator/denominator' tuple in the frozen column order; implemented in scripts/civil_comments_freeze.py (z_key_exact)
conditioning.uninformative_strata: pure-A and singleton strata contribute no information and are omitted, per the existing conditional-audit implementation (Strata.n_usable)

z_sensitivity.subtype_bins: {0}, (0, 1/2), [1/2, 1] for each of the six subtypes
z_sensitivity.boundary_behavior: exact rational comparisons as written; implemented in scripts/civil_comments_freeze.py (bin_overall_toxicity, bin_subtype); no alternative bin definitions may be tested
z_sensitivity.purpose: addresses the varying-annotator-count lattice implicit in exact fractions

evaluator.name: Detoxify-original
evaluator.architecture: bert-base-uncased, BertForSequenceClassification with 6 sigmoid heads (Detoxify original)
evaluator.training_corpus: Jigsaw 2018 Toxic Comment Classification Challenge (Wikipedia talk-page comments); explicitly DISTINCT from the Civil Comments / Jigsaw 2019 unintended-bias corpus being evaluated
evaluator.why_not_unbiased: Detoxify-unbiased was trained on the Civil Comments lineage and is therefore excluded as primary evaluator
evaluator.scoring_path: Detoxify(model_type='original', checkpoint=<local ckpt>, device='cpu').predict(batch) -- the package's intended sigmoid scoring path (torch.sigmoid over logits inside detoxify.detoxify.Detoxify.predict); no generic Hugging Face pipeline

environment.precision: float32 (torch default; no autocast, no half precision)
environment.load_verified: 2026-08-27: Detoxify instantiation from the pinned local checkpoint succeeded under these versions; no comment was scored

tokenizer.class: transformers.BertTokenizer (as selected by the checkpoint config)
tokenizer.truncation_policy: truncation at 512 tokens is normal evaluator behavior, disclosed as a limitation; it is NOT an exclusion

deterministic_scoring.preprocessing: comment_text passed verbatim (A-free; no cleaning, no normalization); the 2 comments with empty text are scored as the empty string
deterministic_scoring.input_ordering: ascending integer comment id over the full 448,000-comment census
deterministic_scoring.batching: fixed partition of that ordering into consecutive batches of 32; batch composition is therefore frozen and independent of A, Z, text length, and article
deterministic_scoring.score_store: raw continuous toxicity probabilities keyed ONLY by comment id, written and hash-frozen BEFORE any identity attribute is joined to evaluator outputs

score_discretization.rule: A-blind pooled decile rule, frozen before any score exists
steps: 2. before joining identity attributes, compute pooled empirical deciles of S
3. nine boundaries at k/10, k = 1..9, via numpy.quantile(method='linear') (Hyndman-Fan type 7)
4. exact-duplicate boundaries collapse deterministically via np.unique (empty category removed; no replacement boundaries)
5. category(s) = #{boundaries <= s} = np.searchsorted(boundaries, s, side='right'); identical S values are never split
6. no other number of bins may be tested
score_discretization.artifacts_to_store: raw continuous scores, frozen decile boundaries, resulting discrete scores, and SHA-256 hashes of each

analysis.statistic: conditional_g2 (identical implementation to the PERSUADE audit: offcriterion.statistics.ConditionalG2 over the full discrete distribution of S conditional on Z)
analysis.descriptive_gap: stratum-size-weighted conditional mean difference of the RAW Detoxify toxicity probability (not the decile index), sign = mean(S | A=1) - mean(S | A=0), aggregated over informative strata with weights n_z / sum(n_z), the same conditional weighting rule as the existing paper's weighted_mean_difference; descriptive companion only, the G2 test remains primary
analysis.multiplicity: Holm across the eight identity p-values

seeds.scheme: numpy.random.SeedSequence(entropy=20260827, spawn_key=(analysis_slot, identity_index)) with identity_index from the frozen identity_order

analysis_slots.2: dependence sensitivity: full census, exact Z
analysis_slots.3: Z sensitivity: one-per-article sample, binned Z
analysis_slots.5: permutation test on the frozen negative-control labels
analysis_slots.9: generation of the frozen negative-control labels (already consumed; results/civil_comments/negative_control_labels.csv)

negative_control.rule: one frozen random relabeling of each A within its exact-Z stratum of the primary sample, preserving stratum-level A counts, generated before any evaluator score existed and never regenerated
negative_control.status: calibration sanity check, not part of the confirmatory family

high_confidence_check.status: optional prespecified robustness check, not headline analysis, not confirmatory evidence
high_confidence_check.rule: A = 1 if identity fraction >= 4/5; A = 0 if identity fraction == 0; comments with intermediate fractions excluded; exact rational comparisons

exclusions.missing_text: rows with empty comment_text are retained and scored as the empty string (2 such rows)
exclusions.missing_article_id: singleton pseudo-article rule above (0 such rows)
exclusions.missing_identity_or_toxicity_fields: a row missing any of the 7 Z fields or 8 A columns would be excluded and logged (0 such rows in the frozen source)
exclusions.tokenizer_or_scoring_failure: true technical failure is excluded and logged per comment id; no other post-scoring exclusion is permitted
exclusions.truncation: 512-token truncation is normal evaluator behavior, not an exclusion
exclusions.extreme_scores: evaluator scores are never excluded for being extreme

feasibility: results/civil_comments/feasibility.json (support counts per identity under exact and binned Z, for the primary sample and the census; clustering diagnostics motivating the one-per-article primary)
interpretation_limitations: human annotation fractions are observed proxies for the intended toxicity construct, not ground truth
exact conditioning cannot guarantee that all construct-relevant variation has been measured
identity mention may correlate with linguistic properties not captured by the seven human toxicity labels
a rejection establishes residual conditional dependence, not causation, discrimination, or unfairness
the full-census sensitivity contains article-level dependence, which is why the one-comment-per-article analysis is primary
Detoxify's 512-token input limit may truncate long comments
